svg.title: One task. Two ways to choose a skill.
svg.desc: A normal matching request lets Claude select a skill; a slash command selects it explicitly. An at-sign file reference supplies input, not a skill.

g.text: One task. Two ways to choose a skill.
CONCEPT DIAGRAM · Follow alongside the walkthrough
“Review this workbook’s sheets and formula risks, read-only.”
Claude can select excel-workbook-review when its description matches.
If selection is unclear, choose the skill explicitly below.
Type / in Claude’s message box and select the skill from the suggestions.
Type @ and choose the actual saved file. Add the task, then send once.
These are message-box actions, not Windows File Explorer address-bar commands.
Automatic selection is not guaranteed. Always inspect the result and its evidence.
